summary: Added a right-click action menu for Macro window list items.
details: Macro rows now offer Run, Rename, Delete, Move Up, and Move Down actions.
The Macro window now has a pin toggle to stay above floating main tabs when needed.
Macro list ordering is saved locally, and user macro renames are applied through the macros folder path guard.
Fixed the Macro window splitter so the list and description panes can be resized.
